idea: Body parts & opposites – BIG and small (THE MALL toy store): a GIANT soft teddy bear pops up right beside Baby Ava and she gasps ('Wow! Look! A BIG teddy!'); chorus 'Big and small! Big and small!'; she stretches her arms out WIDE to show how BIG the teddy is ('Big, big, big! Arms out wide! My teddy is so big!'); then a tiny little teddy sits on her open palm ('Small, small, small! A tiny teddy! Hands close together! Small, small!'); copy-me: arms out wide for big, hands close together for small; she holds both and asks the viewer 'Which one is small? Hmm?' (pause) – 'This one! Small! Yay!'; lesson: opposites big and small. Loop: the hook framing again, the giant teddy and the tiny teddy together, bye-bye wave.
title: Wow! A BIG Teddy! 🧸 Big and Small with Baby Ava | Learn Opposites | Crayon Babies
description:
Wow! A GIANT teddy bear pops up beside Baby Ava at the toy store! 🧸 Then a teeny-tiny teddy sits right on her hand. Sing along and learn the opposites BIG and small with Baby Ava.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Wow! Look! A BIG teddy!"
🙆 Big, big, big! Arms out wide!
🐻 Small, small, small! A tiny teddy!
👐 Big = arms out wide, small = hands close together – copy me!
🤔 "Which one is small?" – can you point to it?
👋 Big and small! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: opposites • big • small • tiny • teddy bear

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun sing-along opposites song for toddlers and preschoolers, with Baby Ava at the toy store discovering a great big teddy bear and a tiny little teddy – a happy, gentle way to learn big and small.
